summary: You need 45 units: 10 units of pre-1800 literature, 10 of post-1800 literature and 5 of theory or methodology, each course taken for 5 units, plus either 20 units of 200-level English electives or the thesis option (an approved petition, 10 units of ENGLISH 399 and 15 elective units), with at least two 300-level courses. Electives must carry at least 3 units each, creative writing courses do not count, ENGLISH 399 counts only toward the thesis option, and at most 5 units of ENGLISH 398 count. Your advisor checks the 3.0 GPA, and the up to two 100-level or outside-department courses the Director of Graduate Studies approves are moved in by hand.
